questions.prompt: Alice and Bob each see two doctors on call and each go off call. Nobody is left. Why isn't this a lost update?
options: Neither overwrote the other's data; each wrote a different row

questions.prompt: Put write skew's pattern in order.
options: Read rows and check a condition, decide, then write something that changes the condition

questions.prompt: Which of these is a write-skew risk?
options: Two customers booking the same meeting room at the same time
One user editing their own profile

options: Lock a row that does exist, such as the room or bay, with FOR UPDATE
